messages:
mike: Heads up, noticed a regression after the SM90 driver bump. Flash v3 is being chosen for a subset of configs (head_dim=14) and throughput drops ~18-25% vs the v2 path we used to pick. Repro on dedicated pool (pool-3) with batch=8, seq=128.

tara: Ugh. Can you paste the profiler snippet and which selector rule flipped?

mike: Profiler summary below (run: batch=8 seq=128 model=gpt-small):
```
Profile summary (ms per token):
- flash_v2_noncausal: 9.2 ms/token
- flash_v3_causal: 11.4 ms/token
- cudnn_fallback: 13.8 ms/token
Selected by kernel_picker: flash_v3_causal
Probe decisions: arch=sm90, seqlen=128, head_dim=14, is_causal=true, policy_version=2026-03-17
Note: head_dim % 8 == 6 seems to trigger a v3-preference branch in the new selector heuristics.
```

chen: Interesting — head_dim 14 is not a common sweet spot. On sm90 the new kernels expect 16-aligned head slices for efficient vector loads; when head_dim=14 we hit an unaligned code path in v3 that increases shared memory usage and causes extra memcpys for KV slices. That explains the perf delta.

noah: Is the KV cache warmup behavior changing too? Any extra memcpy/reshuffle in the timeline?

mike: Yes, flame graphs show a spike in memcpy+kv_pack for the v3 flow. Link: https://perf.local/flare/2740002222 (internal). KV packing time goes from ~0.9ms -> ~2.6ms per step for head_dim=14 on v3.

perf: Adding to this — autotuner probe favors v3 based on microbench numbers we gathered on SM90, but the probe uses head_dim alignment test (mod 8) rather than measuring actual vector load pattern. That heuristic misfires for 14 (6 mod 8) vs 15/16.

tara: So two levers: 1) change selector heuristic to account for head_stride/alignment (prefer v2 when head_dim < 16 unless proven), 2) introduce a quick runtime pad to 16 for KV packing for problematic heads as temporary mitigation. Thoughts?

chen: Runtime pad would be cheap to try. We can add a small pad-to-16 in the KV pack path when head_dim % 16 != 0 and target_arch==sm90 and head_dim < 32. That should avoid the unaligned loads that blow up v3.

noah: Prefer selector change first (non-invasive). Update kernel_picker to add a rule: if arch==sm90 && head_dim < 16 && seqlen <= 256 -> prefer flash_v2_noncausal for causal path. That prevents v3 being chosen until we have friendly codegen for small, unaligned heads.

perf: Agreed. I can run an autotuner sweep that adds a tiny microbenchmark for head_dim in [12,16) to get real numbers and publish them. Will also add a per-arch alignment flag to the probe output.

infra-bot: deploybot: rolled back driver build to sm90-2026-03-10 on pool-3 at 2026-03-17T21:14Z (action by @infra). Pools affected: pool-3,dedicated-canary.

mike: Thanks — rollback unblocks prod but we need a short-term runtime fix + selector patch. Action items: 1) @chen add KV-pad patch and smoke test (low-risk) 2) @perf run microbench sweep and post numbers 3) @tara or @mike open kernel_picker PR with the head_dim < 16 rule and add test vectors.

chen: I'll open a draft PR for the pad tonight, include perf numbers from my local.

perf: Sweep scheduled in perf-lab tomorrow morning, I'll drop results in this thread and add a CSV.

tara: I'll own the kernel_picker PR review and coordinate canary rollout.

mike: Great. TL;DR: regression caused by selector heuristic + head_dim alignment on sm90 leading to v3 being chosen for 14-head models. Short-term: rollback done, patch + selector rule in flight, perf sweep to validate. :eyes:

noah: Also log for postmortem: add case to regression suite for head_dim in {13,14,15} on sm90 with causal/noncausal toggles.

mike: Good call. I'll add test to perf-regressions.

perf: Ping me when PRs land, I'll re-run the sweep against the patched binary.

infra-bot: reminder: create incident ticket if customer-facing SLA impacted. (no incidents open)

mike: closing loop — will update thread after PR merges.
